live_network_tests.network_method: Candidate download() with stdlib HTTPSHandler, normal environment proxy configuration, strict official GitHub host and redirect allowlist, certificate and hostname verification enabled.
Unmodified candidate download() with standard verified HTTPS and unchanged strict official GitHub redirect allowlist.

result.test_scope: Package preparation and manifests only; no installer execution, asset copy or base download.

historical_package_preparation.relationship: The candidate changes only the HTTPS transport and its tests. ZIP, delta, asset inventory and reconstruction code are unchanged; this historical check is not represented as a rerun of the candidate.

transport_compatibility.change: Replace custom direct-address HTTPS transport and disabled proxies with standard urllib HTTPSHandler using ssl.create_default_context() and ordinary environment proxy configuration. No direct DNS prerequisite remains on the download route.
transport_compatibility.security_tradeoff: The candidate relies on normal DNS/proxy routing and the configured certificate trust store instead of connecting directly to a prevalidated numeric address. Arbitrary destination domains remain forbidden. Hostname and certificate verification plus immutable content hashes still authenticate the allowed official GitHub downloads. This restores ordinary enterprise/cloud proxy compatibility without disabling TLS checks.
